Summary: An ad-hoc payment of at least 75% of the net bill amount shall be made within 10 working days, and the remaining payment after final checking within 28 working days of submission.
Quote: An amount of ad-hoc payment not less than 75% of the net amount of the bill under check, shall be made within 10 working days of submission of the bill. The remaining payment is also to be made after final checking of the bill within 28 working days of submission of bill by the contractor.
Notes: Ad-hoc payment of >=75% is due within 10 working days; remaining payment is due within 28 working days. Interest applies after 45 days.

Summary: A security deposit of 2.5% is deducted from the gross amount of each running and final bill until it reaches 2.5% of the tendered amount.
Quote: The person(s) whose tender may be accepted (hereinafter called the contractor) shall permit Government at the time of making any payment to him for work done under the contract to deduct a sum at the rate of 2.5% of the gross amount of each running and final bill till the sum deducted will amount to security deposit of 2.5% of the tendered amount of the work.
Notes: The term is referred to as Security Deposit deducted from running bills and final bill at the rate of 2.5%, capped at an overall security deposit of 2.5% of the tendered amount.

Summary: Mobilization advances not exceeding 10% of the tendered amount may be given, bearing simple interest at the rate of 8 percent per annum.
Quote: Mobilization advances not exceeding 10% of the tendered amount may be given, if requested by the contractor in writing within six months of the order to commence the work.
Notes: The mobilization advance bears simple interest at the rate of 8 percent per annum. It is released in two or more installments (each not exceeding 5% of the tendered amount) and is recovered from contractor's bills once 10% of the gross value of the work is executed and paid, up to 80% of the contract value.

Summary: The contractor shall pay compensation for delay at the rate of 0.75% of the accepted tendered amount per month, subject to a maximum cap of 5% of the accepted tendered value.
Quote:
(i)
Compensation for delay of work
@ 0.75%  of accepted tendered amount per month
of delay (to be computed on per day basis)
Notes: The total amount of compensation for delay shall not exceed 5% of the accepted Tendered Value of work or of the accepted Tendered Value of the Sectional part of work. Additionally, in cases of contract determination, the total recovery against compensation under clause 2 plus clause 3 shall not exceed 8% of the accepted tendered value of work.

Summary: Price escalation clause is applicable for the construction period with compensation worked out at quarterly intervals based on material and labour components.
Quote:
Clause 10 CC – Applicable
A.
For construction period
Notes: Clause 10 CC is marked as applicable for the construction period. Specific percentage breakdowns for cement, labour, steel, etc., are to be filled in the schedule.

Summary: The contractor must provide a performance guarantee in the form of Insurance Surety Bonds, Demand Draft, Fixed Deposit Receipt or Bank Guarantee, but the percentage amount is not specified in the excerpts.
Quote: Insurance Surety Bonds, Account Payee Demand Draft, Fixed Deposit Receipt or Bank Guarantee from any of the Commercial Banks.
Notes: The excerpts mention the requirement of a performance guarantee (which can be a Bank Guarantee) and its validity terms, but do not state the numeric percentage value of the performance security.
